[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37718957/798df49a611daa83683770a11ba4304adca68ea9.jpg[/img]
Thanks for sharing the error log file with me, I guess the black-screen bug is fixed in V1.1.2. However I don't have a machine to test this issue. Please let me know if the bug is fixed or not. Thanks a lot and sorry about bugs. BTW, zero-damage is the same bug according to the log file.

notes.title: V 1.1.1 Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37718957/2d56832994f58746f0c1747669fa53779f7b7c1c.png[/img]
Sorry for the previous update. Engine is upgraded again to fix some hardware incompatible issues. I used the latest stable version of Unity (ver. 2020.1.0f1) that was just released a week ago, I hope it helps. I've tested it on all available machine I can get, including nVidia Gefore 840M, GTX 970, 1050 Ti. Please let me know if you still run into any problems, I'll try my best to help you. Thank you very much.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37718957/2d56832994f58746f0c1747669fa53779f7b7c1c.png[/img]

Hey, guys. Sorry for not having many updates recently, I'm busy working on upgrading the engine. If you run into any other graphic problems please let me know. Thank you very much.
